title: CoralSMP - Server
description: A revived server with a cleaner name and a more straightforward identity. CoralSMP keeps the original spirit, now presented in a fresher and more refined way.
body:
# 🌊 CoralSMP

A fresh take on a classic survival experience. **CoralSMP** brings back a familiar style of gameplay, but with a cleaner identity and a more refined direction.

## ✨ What to Expect

* Vanilla+ survival experience
* Stable and well-maintained server
* Community-focused gameplay
* Balanced features without overcomplication

## 🔒 Whitelist Access

CoralSMP is a **whitelisted server** to ensure a high-quality community.

👉 Join our Discord to request access:
🔗 [https://discord.gg/zeuser](https://discord.gg/zeuser)

## 🌍 Join the Community

We focus on creating a relaxed, friendly environment where players can build, explore, and collaborate.
